slides.title: What nobody tells you before your ==first digital SAT==
Desmos is on every math question
slides.body: The calculator is built into Bluebook, one click away, allowed on everything — there is no no-calculator section anymore. If you're not fluent in it before test day, you're leaving whole minutes on the table.
slides.tip: Practice with it open from day one

slides.title: Flag it, move on, come back
slides.body: Marking a question for review costs nothing and rescues your pacing — stubbornness on one hard question is how students run out of clock. And never leave a blank, because there is no penalty for a wrong guess.
slides.tip: A blank is the only guaranteed zero

slides.title: Each module locks behind you
slides.body: When a module's time ends, it's gone — you can't scroll back from Module 2 to fix Module 1. Review your flagged questions *inside* the module, in the time you banked on the easy ones.
slides.tip: Bank time early, spend it before the lock
